title: English Conversation 4:  Office Rumor
content: 1. office rumor: a story, gossip, or piece of news that may or may not be true that many people in an office or company are talking about - Have you heard the latest office rumor? - She is always spreading office rumors. 2. to lay off: to fire or discharge a worker from a job (sometimes temporarily) - The company laid off 100 workers last month. - Do you think the company will lay off a lot of people? 3. several: more than 2 but not many - I have been to several countries. - We have been working on this for several hours.
